At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
  
  
We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.
  
  
**Our Team**
The Netflix Ads Identity and Audiences team is committed to providing a relevant and engaging advertising experience that prioritizes member privacy. Our mission is to maintain accurate member identities, ensuring that ads are both engaging and compliant with consumer privacy choices and regional regulations.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Privacy Software Engineer on the Ads Identity and Audiences team, you will play a crucial role in safeguarding Netflix member privacy across the Netflix Ads Suite. Your primary focus will be on designing and implementing privacy-preserving technologies that ensure ads are not only engaging but also fully respectful of consumer privacy choices and compliant with regional regulations.
  
  
In this dynamic and innovative environment, your contributions will have a significant impact on how we protect member data and privacy. You will collaborate with a team of talented professionals who are deeply passionate about technology and privacy, fostering a culture that values creativity, diversity, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Skills & Experience We’re Seeking**

* Professional experience in designing and building privacy features for ad platforms, with a focus on user data protection and compliance.
* Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and security concepts, including Privacy by Design principles.
* Experience with implementing data privacy protections such as data minimization, encryption, and deidentification techniques.
* In-depth knowledge of regional privacy regulations, e.g. GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act), and CPRA (California Privacy Rights Act).
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, or similar, with a strong grasp of software development principles and design patterns.
* Experience in developing distributed cloud-based applications and proficiency in modern programming languages, preferably object-oriented.
* Proven experience in handling data at extremely large volumes with big data tools like Spark, and building high throughput low latency distributed systems that utilized the big data.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and effectively manage multiple priorities.
* Knowledge of the ad tech and advertising landscape, including programmatic advertising and digital marketing trends.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

**Nice To Haves**

* Experience with Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PETs)
* Experience integrating with Consent Management Platforms (CMPs)
* Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints.
* Contribution to ad tech privacy industry groups (e.g. IAB Tech Lab).

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $499,000.00 - $900,000.00.
  
  
Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.
  
  
Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

 Position Summary     Early Development (gRED), within Early Clinical Development Informatics (ECDi), is seeking an experienced Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize tools and platforms that accelerate clinical trial development and help bring life-changing medicines to patients faster. 
In this role, you’ll work with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to turn complex requirements into scalable software solutions. You’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle, building responsive applications, strengthening automated testing, and supporting cloud infrastructure and deployment practices. 
 Key Responsibilities     Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate complex requirements into scalable, end-to-end software solutions.   Build and maintain responsive, intuitive user interfaces and applications using modern JavaScript and ReactJS.   Develop and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end test automation using tools such as Playwright, PyTest, and Jest.   Support DevOps best practices by building and managing CI/CD pipelines with tools such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.   Provision, manage, and monitor AWS cloud infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.   Participate in the full software development lifecycle in an Agile environment, including system design, coding, code reviews, and architecture planning. 
 
 Required Qualifications     Five or more years of software engineering experience focused on building and supporting scalable production web applications.   Proficiency in backend development with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.   Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and ReactJS.   Experience with AWS and modern DevOps and deployment practices, including Docker, CI/CD tools, and IaC.   Experience writing automated tests and working with modern testing frameworks for frontend and backend applications.   Effective use of AI-assisted development tools—such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or Cursor—to support coding, testing, and documentation.   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to clean, maintainable, and testable code. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications     Experience building data-intensive applications that manipulate and visualize complex datasets.   Experience supporting production applications, including system monitoring, incident response, and infrastructure troubleshooting.   Experience designing and developing end-to-end automated test frameworks for complex production web applications.   Proficiency in SQL, including writing complex queries and optimizing database performance in systems such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.   Knowledge of industry data standards and regulatory requirements, such as 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, and HIPAA/GDPR.
